title: Governor (primary frequency response)
description: Speed governor: the lumped centre-of-inertia response of the frequency model and the per-machine TGOV1, IEEEG1, hydro and GAST governor models (whose required parameters have no code default). Frequency: Mark-gated. markGated (N312, October 2026): false on every parameter a gridsim-dynamics/2 file feeds into the RMS study (F23, wired); model and droopPu stay true because they also set the Mark-gated lumped frequency model, as do the lumped-only governorTimeConstantS and responsiveFraction.

model.description: Governor model: the lumped centre-of-inertia primary response, or a per-machine TGOV1, IEEEG1, hydro or GAST (simple gas turbine with exhaust temperature load limit) governor. HYGOV names GridSim's simplified hydro governor (N312): the transient-droop governor (permanent droop droopPu, transient droop, dashpot reset, gate servo) driving an ideal, lossless water column, which is the PSS/E HYGOV structure WITHOUT the turbine gain At, the no-load flow qNL, the turbine damping Dturb and the gate velocity limit. Those four have no key here, so a full PSS/E HYGOV data set is represented only approximately. GGOV1 (the GE general governor-turbine model, PSS/E GGOV1) takes the ggov1... parameters (the electrical-power feedback, PID, load limiter, acceleration limiter and actuator) with droopPu (R), valveMaxPu and valveMinPu (Vmax, Vmin) and turbineDampingPu (Dm). WSIEG1 (the WECC modified IEEE type 1 steam governor) takes the wsieg1... parameters (IEEEG1's structure with the nonlinear gate-to-flow table) with valveMaxPu and valveMinPu (PMAX, PMIN). IEEEG3 (the IEEE 1973 hydro governor, PSS/E IEEEG3) takes the ieeeg3... parameters with droopPu (the permanent droop sigma) and valveMaxPu and valveMinPu (PMAX, PMIN); its turbine coefficients a11, a13, a21 and a23 default to the ideal turbine 0.5, 1, 1.5, 1.

droopPu.description: Governor droop R (pu speed per pu power). TWO DIFFERENT code values (inconsistency register).

governorTimeConstantS.description: Primary-response lag of the lumped governor (s). Literature-typical, unfitted.

responsiveFraction.description: Share of generation that responds (headroom) in the lumped model. Literature-typical, unfitted.

turbineDampingPu.description: TGOV1 turbine damping Dt, GAST DTURB (pu). Absent: 0 for both.

valveMinPu.description: Valve / gate lower limit (pu on the machine base). Absent: 0 (also for GAST VMIN).

valveMaxPu.description: Valve / gate upper limit (pu on the machine base): TGOV1 VMAX, IEEEG1 PMAX, hydro gate maximum, GAST VMAX. Absent: unlimited (GAST included). Read by a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ValveTimeS.description: TGOV1 valve / steam-bowl lag T1 (s). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ReheatLeadS.description: TGOV1 reheat lead T2 (s). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ReheatLagS.description: TGOV1 reheat lag T3 (s, above 0). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LagS.description: IEEEG1 governor lag T1 (s); 0 together with a zero lead is the pure droop gain. Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LeadS.description: IEEEG1 governor lead T2 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ValveTimeS.description: IEEEG1 valve servo time constant T3 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ChestS.description: IEEEG1 steam-chest time constant T4 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ReheatS.description: IEEEG1 reheater time constant T5 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1CrossoverS.description: IEEEG1 crossover time constant T6 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LpS.description: IEEEG1 second crossover / LP time constant T7 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1K2.description: IEEEG1 LP-shaft fraction K2 (R083). The eight fractions K1..K8 are fractions of the total turbine power and must sum to 1.

ieeeg1UoPuPerS.description: IEEEG1 maximum valve opening rate Uo (R083), in pu of the machine base per second (MW/s per MW of rating); above 0. Absent: unlimited.

ieeeg1UcPuPerS.description: IEEEG1 maximum valve closing rate Uc (R083), in pu of the machine base per second, below 0. Absent: unlimited.

hygovTransientDroopPu.description: Hydro governor transient droop Rt (the permanent droop Rp is droopPu). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovResetTimeS.description: Hydro governor dashpot reset time Tr (s, above 0). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovGateTimeS.description: Hydro governor gate servo time constant Tg (s). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovWaterTimeS.description: Hydro water starting time Tw (s, above 0; ideal water column). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

gastValveTimeS.description: GAST governor mechanism (fuel valve) time constant T1 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastTurbineTimeS.description: GAST turbine power time constant T2 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastExhaustTimeS.description: GAST exhaust temperature time constant T3 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastAmbientLimitPu.description: GAST ambient temperature load limit AT (pu on the machine base): the turbine power the exhaust temperature limit settles at; the initial mechanical power must not exceed it. Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastTemperatureGain.description: GAST temperature limiter gain KT (0 or above). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Rselect.description: GGOV1 droop feedback Rselect: 1 electrical power, 0 none (isochronous), -1 fuel valve stroke, -2 governor output. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Flag.description: GGOV1 fuel source switch Flag: 0 fuel flow independent of speed, 1 proportional to speed. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TpelecS.description: GGOV1 electrical power transducer time constant Tpelec (s); 0 passes the power through. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1MaxErrPu.description: GGOV1 maximum speed error signal maxerr (pu). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1MinErrPu.description: GGOV1 minimum speed error signal minerr (pu). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kpgov.description: GGOV1 governor proportional gain Kpgov. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kigov.description: GGOV1 governor integral gain Kigov (1/s). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kdgov.description: GGOV1 governor derivative gain Kdgov. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TdgovS.description: GGOV1 governor derivative time constant Tdgov (s); above 0 when Kdgov is above 0. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TactS.description: GGOV1 actuator time constant Tact (s). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kturb.description: GGOV1 turbine gain Kturb; above 0. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1WfnlPu.description: GGOV1 no-load fuel flow Wfnl (pu). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TbS.description: GGOV1 turbine lag time constant Tb (s); Tb = Tc = 0 bypasses the lead-lag. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TcS.description: GGOV1 turbine lead time constant Tc (s). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1TengS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: the diesel transport delay Teng (s). Only 0 (the default) is modelled; any other value is refused.

ggov1TfloadS.description: GGOV1 load limiter (temperature measurement) time constant Tfload (s). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kpload.description: GGOV1 load limiter proportional gain Kpload; with Kiload 0 as well, the load limiter is left out. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kiload.description: GGOV1 load limiter integral gain Kiload (1/s). Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1LdrefPu.description: GGOV1 load limiter reference Ldref (pu); a high value deactivates the limiter. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1RopenPuPerS.description: GGOV1 maximum valve opening rate Ropen (pu/s); above 0. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1RclosePuPerS.description: GGOV1 maximum valve closing rate Rclose (pu/s); below 0. Required for model GGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ggov1Kimw.description: Optional for model GGOV1: supervisory load controller (reset) gain Kimw (1/s); 0 (the default) is none.

ggov1AsetPuPerS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: acceleration limiter set point Aset (pu/s); default 0.

ggov1Ka.description: Optional for model GGOV1: acceleration limiter gain Ka; 0 (the default) leaves the limiter out.

ggov1TaS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: acceleration limiter time constant Ta (s); 0 (the default) leaves the limiter out.

ggov1TrateMw.description: Optional for model GGOV1: turbine rating Trate (MW). Above 0: the GGOV1 per-unit values are on the turbine rating, converted to the machine base in the study; 0 (the default): on the machine base.

ggov1DbPu.description: Optional for model GGOV1: speed governor deadband db. Only 0 (the default) is modelled; any other value is refused.

ggov1TsaS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: temperature detection lead time constant Tsa (s); default 0.

ggov1TsbS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: temperature detection lag time constant Tsb (s); default 0 (Tsa = Tsb = 0 bypasses the lead-lag).

ggov1RupPuPerS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: maximum rate of load limit increase Rup (pu/s), on the load limiter integral; above 0, default 99.

ggov1RdownPuPerS.description: Optional for model GGOV1: maximum rate of load limit decrease Rdown (pu/s); below 0, default -99.

wsieg1K.description: WSIEG1 governor gain K (the reciprocal of the droop); above 0. Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T1S.description: WSIEG1 governor lag time constant T1 (s); T1 = T2 = 0 is the pure gain. Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T2S.description: WSIEG1 governor lead time constant T2 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T3S.description: WSIEG1 valve servo time constant T3 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1UoPuPerS.description: WSIEG1 maximum valve opening rate Uo (pu/s); above 0. Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1UcPuPerS.description: WSIEG1 maximum valve closing rate Uc (pu/s); below 0. Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T4S.description: WSIEG1 steam chest time constant T4 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T5S.description: WSIEG1 reheater time constant T5 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T6S.description: WSIEG1 crossover time constant T6 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1T7S.description: WSIEG1 second crossover time constant T7 (s). Required for model WSIEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

wsieg1K1.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K1 (HP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 1.

wsieg1K2.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K2 (LP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K3.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K3 (HP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K4.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K4 (LP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K5.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K5 (HP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K6.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K6 (LP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K7.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K7 (HP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1K8.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the stage fraction K8 (LP shaft); the eight sum to 1. Default 0.

wsieg1Db1Pu.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the intentional deadband db1. Only 0 (the default) is modelled; any other value is refused.

wsieg1ErrPu.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the intentional deadband hysteresis err. Only 0 (the default) is modelled.

wsieg1Db2Pu.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: the unintentional deadband db2. Only 0 (the default) is modelled.

wsieg1Gv1.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: gate position GV1 of the nonlinear gain table (pu); all ten table values 0 (the default) is the identity.

wsieg1Pgv1.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: steam flow PGV1 at GV1 of the nonlinear gain table (pu).

wsieg1Gv2.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: gate position GV2 of the nonlinear gain table (pu); all ten table values 0 (the default) is the identity.

wsieg1Pgv2.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: steam flow PGV2 at GV2 of the nonlinear gain table (pu).

wsieg1Gv3.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: gate position GV3 of the nonlinear gain table (pu); all ten table values 0 (the default) is the identity.

wsieg1Pgv3.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: steam flow PGV3 at GV3 of the nonlinear gain table (pu).

wsieg1Gv4.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: gate position GV4 of the nonlinear gain table (pu); all ten table values 0 (the default) is the identity.

wsieg1Pgv4.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: steam flow PGV4 at GV4 of the nonlinear gain table (pu).

wsieg1Gv5.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: gate position GV5 of the nonlinear gain table (pu); all ten table values 0 (the default) is the identity.

wsieg1Pgv5.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: steam flow PGV5 at GV5 of the nonlinear gain table (pu).

wsieg1Iblock.description: Optional for model WSIEG1: IBLOCK, PSS/E's limit initialisation: 1 sets a PMIN of 0 to the initial gate, 2 a PMAX of 0, 3 both; 0 (the default) keeps them.

ieeeg3TgS.description: IEEEG3 gate servomotor time constant TG (s), above 0. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3TpS.description: IEEEG3 pilot valve time constant TP (s). Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3UoPuPerS.description: IEEEG3 gate opening rate limit Uo (pu of the machine base per second), above 0. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3UcPuPerS.description: IEEEG3 gate closing rate limit Uc (pu of the machine base per second), below 0. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3TransientDroopPu.description: IEEEG3 transient droop delta. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3TrS.description: IEEEG3 transient droop (dashpot) time constant TR (s), above 0. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3TwS.description: IEEEG3 water starting time TW (s), above 0. Required for model IEEEG3 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

ieeeg3A11.description: IEEEG3 turbine coefficient a11, above 0. Default 0.5 (the ideal turbine).

ieeeg3A23.description: IEEEG3 turbine coefficient a23, above 0. Default 1.
